purpose: Prevent course-shape and last-days language from being rendered as a timing engine.
hard_rules: No public surface may convert a record into “how long left” guidance.
No public surface may infer hospice eligibility, treatment appropriateness, or insurance/benefit status from a trajectory record.
No reader query may return a countdown, probability, or deterministic phase unless the query is routed to qualified local clinical care instead.
Every trajectory record must include “not a prognosis” or equivalent nonclaim.
Trajectories may explain uncertainty; they may not erase it.
preferred_phrases: has been witnessed in some courses
can be part of a pattern
may help explain why this feels uncertain
not all people follow this pattern
